title: Missing observability: no logging or metrics emitted on click recording

finding.claim: Missing observability: no logging or metrics emitted on click recording
finding.recommendation: Add structured logging or emit a metric counter when a click is recorded, consistent with the pattern used for view recording (if any).

code_region.text:
diff --git a/app/metrics.py b/app/metrics.py
--- a/app/metrics.py
+++ b/app/metrics.py
@@ -12,3 +12,7 @@ def record_view(store, page_id):
     count = store.get(f"views:{page_id}") or 0
     store.set(f"views:{page_id}", count + 1)
+
+def record_click(store, page_id):
+    count = store.get(f"clicks:{page_id}") or 0
+    store.set(f"clicks:{page_id}", count + 1)
code_region.note: region is the benchmark case diff under review (bench/corpus/race-counter-increment/diff.patch)
